[SWS_DM_00194]
⌈
If the Diagnostic Server instance receives
a UDS request to clear user-defined fault memory according to [SWS_DM_00193], the
DM shall get the number of user-defined fault memory to be cleared from the fifth byte
in the request.
⌋
